sara_ml: heads up — bringing up hf://goliath-3b-instruct for onboarding. conversion-cli failed basic checks. seeing a few config mismatches: rope_scaling present as {"type": "dynamic", "factor": 0.8} in HF config, but our converter expects a numeric float or absent. sliding_window is true in config.json but the chat template uses truncation flags, which looked odd. num_key_value_heads: HF model reports 8 but config.json has 12. max_position_embeddings is 4096 on the weight metadata but runtime defaults to 2048 -> kv cache shape errors.

devon_infra: saw logs: `RuntimeError: KV cache shape mismatch (expected 12, got 8)` — reproducer saved at /tmp/goliath_convert.log. quick grep shows converter applied default kv_heads=12 fallback when config field missing.

alex_quant: quant tests are showing subtle generation drift after q4_0 quantization. attention patterns look shifted which often correlates with rope scaling mismatch. do not blindly force a rope_scaling value without evals.

mira_research: tokenizer note: HF special token `''` ends up being dropped in our mapping. chat template uses `<|system|>` and `<|assistant|>` markers; conversion currently rewrites system-><s> which breaks chat parsing. propose a mapping table in the converter: {
```
HF: {'': '' , '<|system|>': '[SYSTEM]', '<|assistant|>': '[ASSISTANT]'}
Redwood: {'': '<|endoftext|>', '[SYSTEM]': '<|system|>', '[ASSISTANT]': '<|assistant|>'}
```
This preserves token ids and avoids silent off-by-one token shifts.

sara_ml: good catch. i'll patch the tokenizer mapping to preserve HF special token ids when possible and add a warning when we remap. also i'll add an assert in conversion smoke that verifies `vocab_size` and `special_tokens_map` alignment.

devon_infra: quick workaround for staging conversion: `conversion-cli convert goliath --override max_position_embeddings=4096 --override num_key_value_heads=8 --force-rope-scaling=0.8` — that gets past the kv head check but it's a hack.

alex_quant: +1 that it's a hack. please run llm-eval (openqa/summ-bleu/safety) after override. rope scaling changes can change recency bias; we saw measurable QA drop in past experiments when applying naive scaling.

mira_research: i'll queue the three eval suites now (openqa-fast, summarization-smoke, safety-regtests). ETA ~30m. also will include a tokenization-consistency check that runs 100 sample prompts through HF tokenizer and our converted tokenizer to compare token ids.

deploy-bot: conversion-ci #872: goliath-3b conversion failed kvhead-check. logs: https://ci.redwood/goliath-3b/job/872

sara_ml: :thumbsup: thanks. i'll land the tokenizer mapping patch and the kv-head assert in the converter, then re-run conversion in staging with devon's overrides behind a feature flag. will attach eval results and the sample-token-id diff.

devon_infra: small doc request: add a converter warning when `sliding_window == true` and the chat template uses `truncate=true` — that combo previously caused silent token-dropping for system prompts.

mira_research: note for onboarding docs: conversion caveats list — rope_scaling must be either a float OR a dict with `legacy_mode:true` to use older scaling; sliding_window requires explicit `cache_window` and `truncate` behavior must be spelled out; num_key_value_heads must match model.extract_kv_heads() or conversion fails; max_position_embeddings used by runtime must be >= model.max_seq_len or we must override at conversion.

alex_quant: once patches are in, i'll run q4_0 and q8_0 quant sweeps on the converted artifact and post generation/regression diffs.

sara_ml: will coordinate. heading to run the patch now and will post findings in this thread. thanks all.
